messages:
reza: heads up - promote stalled. CI job 'publish-release' returned uploader error: wrote 0 bytes then runner reported disk_evicted. deploy-bot auto-paused.
ana: can you paste the error line?
reza: `ERROR: failed to write /tmp/out/release_v2.tar.gz: no space left on device (disk_evicted)`
ci-bot: uploader retried 1/3 with concurrency=6; final status: UPLOAD_FAILED.
deploy-bot: Promotion paused for release_v2 due to artifact upload failure. Manual-unblock required after replacement artifact or checksum verified.
ops-bot: logged hold: release_v2 paused at 2026-03-21T20:12:13Z. Change window owner: @ana.
nana: plan: 1) pin previous stable (v1.9.8) for the window; 2) rerun CI on io-heavy runners with `CONCURRENCY=2` + `CLEAN_TMP=true`; 3) if still failing, switch to streaming upload to avoid disk.
reza: queued rerun on io-heavy, ETA ~8m. adding pre-step `rm -rf /tmp/out/*`.
ci-bot: rerun started @6372223350.
ci-bot: rerun result: upload succeeded but post-upload checksum mismatch. expected sha256 abcde.. got 12345..
nana: checksum mismatch => do not promote. open BUILD-4391 to investigate nondeterminism. pin stable and notify PMs.
deploy-bot: Manual-unblock command available: `deploy-bot unblock --thread 6372223333 --by <owner>`; requires checksum proof.
ops-bot: hold recorded and release notes updated: "Promotion paused - CI artifact upload/disk eviction; pinned to v1.9.8."
reza: thanks, will follow up in ticket.
